sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed the Department of Justice's response to 51 recommendations from six reports on prison misconduct risks.
sentences.support: Across the six reports, the Commission made a total of 51 recommendations to DoJ.

sentences.text: The review examined governance, prison security, supervision, staff training and reporting, including observations at six prisons.
sentences.support: Commission officers observed a range of nominated operational practices at six prisons

sentences.text: The Commission recognised substantial change and considered that 37 recommendations had been adequately addressed.
sentences.support: The Commission considers that DoJ has taken appropriate steps to address 37 of the 51 recommendations.

sentences.text: The Commission left 14 recommendations open for further work and planned another review after 12 months.
sentences.support: The Commission considers that 14 recommendations require further work and will review DoJ's progress again in 12 months.

findings.quote: The Commission considers that DoJ has taken appropriate steps to address 37 of the 51 recommendations.
The Commission considers that 14 recommendations require further work and will review DoJ's progress again in 12 months.

notes: Introduction provides the history, scope and consolidated review outcome.
